Record Class TextEffectSegment

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.TextEffectSegment
Record Components:
x - original horizontal origin in GUI pixels
y - original vertical origin in GUI pixels
width - nominal layout width before whole-segment transformation
scaleX - horizontal multiplier
scaleY - vertical multiplier
offsetX - horizontal translation in GUI pixels
offsetY - vertical translation in GUI pixels
shearY - vertical change per horizontal GUI pixel
whole - whether a whole-segment effect supplied this transform
public record TextEffectSegment(float x, float y, float width, float scaleX, float scaleY, float offsetX, float offsetY, float shearY, boolean whole) extends Record
Captures a complete segment's affine transform at the current animation time.

Translation moves the segment, scaling acts around its center, and vertical shear changes height across its horizontal span. Sampling these once keeps a breathing or flipping word on one transform while retaining its nominal layout width.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static TextEffectSegment create(IChromaticEffect effect, float x, float y, float width)
      Samples a whole-segment effect, or returns a neutral transform for ordinary glyph effects.

      The native caller supplies the run's original pen position and the sum of its glyph advances. Geometry callbacks are sampled at that x/y once for the run, before any whole-segment transform. The resulting width remains the nominal layout width; scaling or moving the visible word does not recompute it.

      Parameters:
      effect - primary effect, or null
      x - original horizontal pen origin in GUI pixels
      y - original vertical pen origin in GUI pixels
      width - nominal segment width in GUI pixels
      Returns:
      immutable transform sampled under the effect's playback clock
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an effect coordinate/multiplier is nonfinite
